metadata.page_title: Sigma Chi Whiteout vs In Purdytory matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 66.4. Sigma Chi Whiteout left 20.9 lineup points on the table, while In Purdytory left 25.4.
summary.historical_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout is 24-17 against In Purdytory across 41 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Sigma Chi Whiteout
summary.winner_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 66.4, led by a 73.2-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Kenneth Walker III (41.1) and D'Andre Swift (37.4).
summary.loser_reason: In Purdytory could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 73.2 points. Terry McLaurin scored 2.4. A best legal lineup added 25.4, still short of the 66.4-point margin.
